page_title: LYO 4-3 STR | Lyon v Strasbourg 30/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' That's the end of the match.
90+10' Jeremy Sebas (Strasbourg) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
90+9' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
90+8' Strasbourg couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Lucas Perri (Lyon) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
90+7' The referee is firm and issues Gift Orban (Lyon) a deserved yellow card.
90+6' Adryelson (Lyon) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
90+1' Problems for Pierre Sage as Duje Caleta-Car is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Adryelson (Lyon) replaces him.
90' There will be a minimum of 9 min. of added time.
90' Duje Caleta-Car (Lyon) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
89' Lyon can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

88' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) wastes a golden opportunity inside the box by shooting straight into the back of an opponent when the goal was at his mercy. Lyon have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
88' Malick Fofana (Lyon) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
87' Pierre Sage has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Tanner Tessmann (Lyon) replacing Nemanja Matic.
86' Abakar Sylla (Strasbourg) commits a rough challenge and Thomas Leonard blows his whistle for a foul.
84' Jeremy Sebas (Strasbourg) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
82' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jeremy Sebas (Strasbourg) is coming onto the pitch as Emanuel Emegha cannot continue after picking up an injury.
81' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lyon comes to nothing.
79' Lyon have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
79' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 21:13.
77' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
75' Thomas Leonard shows a yellow card to Marvin Senaya (Strasbourg) for his blatant foul.
74' Liam Rosenior prepares a substitution. Saidou Sow is replaced by Diego Moreira (Strasbourg).
72' 4 - 3 Gift Orban (Lyon) reacts well to a deflected cross from Malick Fofana and places a close-range header beyond the keeper into the left of the goal. 4:3.
71' One of the players from Lyon times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
69' Today's match ends for Habib Diarra who will be replaced by Marvin Senaya (Strasbourg).
68' Liam Rosenior has decided to make a change. Sekou Mara (Strasbourg) replaces Sebastian Nanasi.
68' Gift Orban (Lyon) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.

65' 3 - 3 The goal stands! That took a long time for referee Thomas Leonard to decide. The relieved Lyon players can finally celebrate. Alexandre Lacazette plays a neat ball into the path of Gift Orban (Lyon), who makes room for a shot and fires in off the right post! 3:3.
64' That looked like an offside in the build-up play and the referee Thomas Leonard is going to take a look using VAR.
63' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Gift Orban (Lyon) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
61' 2 - 3 Goal! Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) fires the rebound inside the right post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:3.
61' OFF THE BAR! Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) found himself some space to take a shot from just outside the box, but Karl-Johan Johnsson came up with a save and tipped the ball onto the bar.
59' Pierre Sage decides to make a substitution. Abner will be replaced by Gift Orban (Lyon).
59' We are about to witness a subsitution. Malick Fofana (Lyon) for Georges Mikautadze.
58' 1 - 3 Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) finds himself one-on-one with the keeper after a great pass by Caleb Wiley. He takes the shot early and scores!

57' It looks like Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) saw red with that tackle. Thomas Leonard won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Strasbourg have a free kick from a promising distance.
57' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) fires the resultant free kick towards the left post, but the keeper makes a brilliant save and denies him the chance to score.
56' Strasbourg take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
55' Caleb Wiley (Strasbourg) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Now Strasbourg have a corner.
53' Wasted effort! Caleb Wiley (Strasbourg) finds himself some space, looks up but sends a dreadful shot high over the bar from long range.
50' A mistake by a defender gifts Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) a chance inside the box, but his wild effort goes well wide of the left post.

48' 1 - 2 A perfect lofted pass from Dilane Bakwa finds Andrey Santos (Strasbourg), who jumps highest and steers a close-range header into the right side of the goal. His effort was both strong and precise, and Lucas Perri had no chance of stopping that. 1:2.
48' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
47' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. Strasbourg win a corner.
46' Liam Rosenior makes a half-time substitution. Caleb Wiley comes on in place of Felix Lemarechal (Strasbourg).
46' The second half has just started.
45+6' Thomas Leonard blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+4' Georges Mikautadze (Lyon) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header flies yards over the crossbar.
45+1' 1 - 1 Goal! 1:1. Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) taps home from almost on the goal line after a lucky rebound fell at his feet.
45+1' A long pass into the box is latched onto by Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon), who looks up and slams a terrific shot past the keeper but onto the left post. He did everything right but score!
45+1' What a sweet touch by Georges Mikautadze (Lyon) as he collects a pass deep inside the box and decides to go for goal. It's on target but easy for Karl-Johan Johnsson to hold.
45' We will have 5 min. of added time.
45' Georges Mikautadze (Lyon) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
44' Georges Mikautadze (Lyon) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Karl-Johan Johnsson pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
42' The ball possession at the moment is 49:51.
40' Nemanja Matic (Lyon) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Thomas Leonard blows his whistle for a foul.
39' Moussa Niakhate (Lyon) is able to continue to play.
37' Moussa Niakhate (Lyon) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
36' Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
34' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Strasbourg, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
34' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
33' Abner (Lyon) has tested the patience of referee Thomas Leonard and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
32' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
30' Abner (Lyon) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
30' Clinton Mata (Lyon) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked. The ball goes out of play and Lyon have been awarded a corner kick.

30' Moussa Niakhate (Lyon) latches on to a perfectly taken corner kick deep into the box and attempts to head home. His bullet header heads straight towards the roof of the net, but it's deflected onto the crossbar by the goalkeeper. A wonderful effort.
29' Abner (Lyon) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
27' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
24' The game is interrupted now, Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
23' Georges Mikautadze (Lyon) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the middle of the goal was easily saved by Karl-Johan Johnsson.
21' Lyon failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

21' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Lyon. Abner (Lyon) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
19' Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Thomas Leonard saw the whole situation.
19' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the net, but Lucas Perri is alert and denies him.

18' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) displays brilliant awareness inside the six-yard box and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the middle of the target, but Karl-Johan Johnsson keeps the ball out.
17' It must be a yellow card. It is. Guela Doue (Strasbourg) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
15' Thomas Leonard has a clear sight and sees a foul from Abner (Lyon).
13' Abner (Lyon) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and Karl-Johan Johnsson easily makes the save.

11' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low drive is headed for the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him.
11' The corner is swung in but Lyon can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

11' Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) connects with an accurate pass inside the box and fires the ball to the bottom right corner, but one of the defending players steps in to block the effort. The ball goes behind for a corner. Lyon will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
9' Abner (Lyon) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.

8' Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety. Lyon force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
8' Georges Mikautadze (Lyon) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. Good work from Lyon as they win a corner.
7' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) dribbles his way into the box and has an effort on goal, but the ball flies way over the bar.
5' Strasbourg seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
3' 0 - 1 Goal! A mistake from the defence gifted a chance to a lurking Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg), who keeps his cool and rolls the ball into the net from close range. 0:1.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Lyon will have the kick-off.
Thomas Leonard will supervise the game today.
